# 1. GROOT - Read-based
# 1.1 Import data
```{r}
all_classes = read.table("Supplementary_table14.tsv", header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

all_classes = all_classes %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = V1,
                AB_class = V2,
                Occurrences = V3)

# Add a VG_ID column
all_classes <- all_classes %>%
  mutate(VG_ID = paste0("VG", str_extract(Sample, "\\d{3}")))  # Extracts the 3-digit number and prepends 'VG'

# Get metadata
metadata = read.delim("VG_metadata.tsv")

# Reduce the metadata to the 225 children samples considered for the analysis
metadata = metadata %>%
  filter(individual == "Child") %>%
  filter(!is.na(SequencingID))

# Add a Resistance column to metadata. Value = Yes if there is at least 1 resistance gene found for that child
metadata$Resistance <- ifelse(metadata$VG_ID %in% all_classes$VG_ID, 1, 2)
table(metadata$Resistance) # 219 Yes and 6 no so all good.

# Add the AB_class variable to metadata
metadata_AB <- metadata %>%
  left_join(all_classes %>% 
              dplyr::select(VG_ID, AB_class, Occurrences), by = "VG_ID")

# Add some metadata to all_classes
all_classes <- all_classes %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% 
              dplyr::select(VG_ID, classif), by = "VG_ID")

```

# 1.2 Effect of explanatory variables on the presence/absence of resistance genes
## 1.2.1 Effect of mode of delivery
```{r}
# Create a contingency table
table_howborn <- table(metadata$howborn_combined, metadata$Resistance)

# Run chi-squared test
chisq.test(table_howborn)

rm(table_howborn)
```

## 1.2.2 Effect of classif
```{r}
# Create a contingency table
table_resistance <- metadata_AB %>%
  filter(Resistance == "1") %>%
  dplyr::count(AB_class, classif) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = classif, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

table_resistance <- table_resistance %>%
  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ . >= 2))

# Function to run Chi-squared or Fisher’s test
test_results <- table_resistance %>%
  column_to_rownames("AB_class") %>%
  split(., rownames(.)) %>%
  map_df(~ {
    tab <- as.matrix(.x)
    if(any(tab < 5)) {
      test <- fisher.test(tab)
      test_type <- "Fisher"
    } else {
      test <- chisq.test(tab)
      test_type <- "Chi-squared"
    }
    data.frame(AB_class = rownames(.x),
               p_value = test$p.value,
               test_type = test_type)
  }, .id = "AB_class")

rm(test_results, table_resistance)
```

# 1.3 Prevalence of each AB_class per classif
```{r}
# Create the prevalence table by classif and AB_class
all_classes_prev <- metadata_AB %>%
  dplyr::group_by(AB_class, classif) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(total = sum(Resistance), .groups = "drop") %>% #sums the occurrences for each group.
  pivot_wider(names_from = classif, values_from = total) #reshapes the table so each classif becomes a column.
  
# Get the proportion in function of the group size
table (metadata$classif)

all_classes_prop = all_classes_prev %>%
  rowwise() %>% # consider the following per row ( = per AB class)
  mutate(`Normally nourished` = `Normally nourished` / 90,
         Overnourished = Overnourished / 97,
         Undernourished = Undernourished / 38) %>%
  ungroup()

all_classes_prop_long <- all_classes_prop %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Normally nourished`, Overnourished, Undernourished),
               names_to = "classif",
               values_to = "normalized_prop"
               )

all_classes_prop_long_wrapped <- all_classes_prop_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(AB_class = str_wrap(AB_class, width = 20))


# Plot
res = ggplot(all_classes_prop_long_wrapped, aes(x = classif, y = normalized_prop*100, fill = classif)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ AB_class) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normally nourished" = "#f7bf83",
                               "Overnourished" = "#83f7bf",
                               "Undernourished" = "#f78583")
                   ) + 
  labs(title = "Resistance by nutritional status and antibiotic class",
       x = "Nutritional status",
       y = "Percentage of children per classif with detected resistance gene",
       fill = "Nutritional status"
       ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
        )

# Identify top 5 AB classes (excluding "Other")
top5_classes <- all_classes %>%
  filter(AB_class != "Other") %>%   # remove "Other"
  dplyr::group_by(AB_class) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_occ = sum(Occurrences, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(total_occ)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(AB_class)

plot_data <- all_classes %>%
  filter(AB_class %in% top5_classes) %>%
  group_by(AB_class) %>%
  mutate(total_occ = sum(Occurrences, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(AB_class = fct_reorder(AB_class, total_occ, .desc = TRUE))

res_all = ggplot(plot_data,
                 aes(y = reorder(AB_class, Occurrences),
                     x = Occurrences,
                     fill = classif)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normally nourished" = "#f7bf83",
                               "Overnourished" = "#83f7bf",
                               "Undernourished" = "#f78583")) +
  labs(title = NULL,
       y = NULL,
       x = "Detection count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(),
        legend.position = "none")


rm(all_classes_prev, all_classes_prop, all_classes_prop_long, all_classes_prop_long_wrapped, res, res_all, plot_data)
```

# 1.4 Occurrences of resistance genes per classif
```{r}
# Normalize Occurrences to the proportions of children in each classif group
table(metadata$classif)

all_classes_weighted = all_classes %>%
  mutate(weighted_occurrences = case_when(classif == "Normally nourished" ~ Occurrences / 90,
                                          classif == "Overnourished" ~ Occurrences / 97,
                                          classif == "Undernourished" ~ Occurrences / 38,
                                          TRUE ~ NA_real_  # in case there's a missing or unmatched classif
                                          ))


KW_results_occ <- all_classes_weighted %>%
  group_by(AB_class) %>%
  kruskal_test(weighted_occurrences ~ classif)

KW_results_occ <- KW_results_occ %>%
  mutate(p_label = paste0("p = ", signif(p, 3)),
         signif_code = case_when(p <= 0.001 ~ "***",
                                 p <= 0.01  ~ "**",
                                 p <= 0.05  ~ "*",
                                 p <= 0.1   ~ ".",
                                 TRUE             ~ " "
                                 ),
         label_with_signif = paste(p_label, signif_code, sep = " ")  # Combine p-value and significance code
         )

# Create the weighted occurrences table by classif and AB_class
all_classes_weighted_occ <- all_classes_weighted %>%
  dplyr::group_by(AB_class, classif) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(total = sum(weighted_occurrences), .groups = "drop") %>% #sums the weighted_occurrences for each group.
  pivot_wider(names_from = classif, values_from = total) #reshapes the table so each classif becomes a column.

all_classes_weighted_occ_long <- all_classes_weighted_occ %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Normally nourished`, Overnourished, Undernourished),
               names_to = "classif",
               values_to = "normalized_occ"
               )

# Modify the 2 datasets to adjust width of title to fit the layout on the graph
all_classes_weighted_occ_long_wrapped <- all_classes_weighted_occ_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(AB_class = str_wrap(AB_class, width = 20))

KW_results_occ_wrapped <- KW_results_occ %>%
    dplyr::mutate(AB_class = str_wrap(AB_class, width = 20))

# Plot the normalized_occurrences in function of the nutritional status
prop_res = ggplot(all_classes_weighted_occ_long_wrapped, aes(x = classif, y = normalized_occ, fill = classif)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ AB_class) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normally nourished" = "#f7bf83",
                               "Overnourished" = "#83f7bf",
                               "Undernourished" = "#f78583")
                    ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average occurrence per child (normalized according to group size)", title = "Resistant genes detected in the stool samples of children at 1wpp") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) + 
  geom_text(data = KW_results_occ_wrapped, # Add p-values with significance codes to each facet
            aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = label_with_signif),  # Position at the top
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = 1.5,
            size = 3.5
  )

rm(all_classes_weighted, KW_results_occ, all_classes_weighted_occ, all_classes_weighted_occ_long, all_classes_weighted_occ_long_wrapped, KW_results_occ_wrapped, prop_res)

```

# 1.5 Focus on Beta-lactam and differences between classif
```{r}
beta_lactam = all_classes %>%
  filter(AB_class == "Beta-lactam")

beta_lactam_occ = beta_lactam %>%
  dplyr::group_by(classif) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(total_occ = sum(Occurrences), .groups = "drop")  #sums the occurrences for each group.
beta_lactam_occ

# Normalize Occurrences to the proportions of children in each classif group
table(metadata$classif)

beta_lactam_occ = beta_lactam_occ %>%
  mutate(norm_occ = case_when(classif == "Normally nourished" ~ total_occ / 90,
                              classif == "Overnourished" ~ total_occ / 97,
                              classif == "Undernourished" ~ total_occ / 38,
                              TRUE ~ NA_real_  # in case there's a missing or unmatched classif
                              ))

# Kruskal–Wallis test first
kruskal.test(norm_occ ~ classif, data = beta_lactam_occ)

# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests
pairwise.wilcox.test(beta_lactam_occ$norm_occ, beta_lactam_occ$classif) # p.adjust.method = "BH")  

# Boxplot representation
BL_plot = ggplot(beta_lactam, aes(x = classif, y = Occurrences)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +  # boxplot overlay
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +  # jittered points
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Normally nourished" = "NN",
                              "Overnourished"      = "ON",
                              "Undernourished"     = "UN")) +
    labs(x = NULL, # "Maternal nutritionnal status"
         y = "Number of Beta-Lactam gene detected") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
          ) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", comparisons = list(c("Undernourished", "Normally nourished"),
                                                                c("Normally nourished", "Overnourished"),
                                                                c("Undernourished", "Overnourished")),
                     label = "p", # p.signif
                     size = 5)

rm(beta_lactam, beta_lactam_occ, BL_plot)
```

# 1.6 Differences of resistome in household with and without chicken
```{r}
# Are certain antibiotic resistance classes more abundant (higher counts) in children with chicken compared to no chicken?
library(MASS)
model <- glm.nb(Occurrences ~ s86, data = subset(metadata_AB, AB_class == "Beta-lactam"))
summary(model)

# Incidence Rate Ratio (IRR) (exponentiated value of the Estimate of s86 = YES)
exp(-0.15184) 

model = glm.nb(Occurrences ~ s86 * AB_class, data = metadata_AB)
summary(model)


library(emmeans)
emm <- emmeans(model, ~ s86 | AB_class, type = "response")
contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
```


# 2. ABRICATE - Assembly-based
## 2.1 Loading the database
```{r}
abricate = read_tsv("Supplementary_table15.tsv", col_names = TRUE)
```

## 2.2 Clean the abricate data
```{r}
# Extracting MAGs name and database name
abricate <- abricate %>%
  dplyr::mutate(MAGs = str_extract(`#FILE`, "(?<=Abricate_out/)[^/]+"),
                Database = str_extract(`#FILE`, "(?<=\\.)[^./]+(?=\\.tab)")
                )

# Replace all the dots values with NA values
abricate <- abricate %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(., ".")))

# Remove all the empty lines
abricate <- abricate %>%
  filter(NUM_FOUND != 0)

# Remove all the empty columns
abricate <- abricate %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

# Create VG_ID column
abricate <- abricate %>%
  mutate(VG_ID = str_extract(MAGs, "(?<=C1WST|MPST)\\d{3}") %>%
           str_c("VG", .)
         )

# Reorder the columns
abricate <- abricate %>%
  dplyr::select(MAGs, VG_ID, Database, NUM_FOUND,everything())

```

## 2.3 Join metadata and taxonomy
```{r}
# Join metadata variables of interest
abricate <- abricate %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% dplyr::select(VG_ID, howborn, classif, district, district_cat), by = "VG_ID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  distinct()

# Import taxonomy of MAGs - MetaPhlan/PhyloPhlan
taxMAGs = read.delim('Supplementary_table9.tsv')
  
taxMAGs <- taxMAGs %>%
  mutate(Unassigned = ifelse(grepl("is close to an SGB not present in the SGB", X.input_bin), # Identify unassigned bins
                             "Not present in DB",
                             ""
                             ),
         X.input_bin = sub(" is close to an SGB not present in the SGB.*$", "", X.input_bin), # Clean bin names (remove trailing message)
         avg_dist = sub("^.*:(\\d+\\.\\d+)$", "\\1", X.u.k._.S.G.F.GBid.taxa_level.taxonomy.avg_dist), # Extract avg_dist (value after last :)
         X.u.k._.S.G.F.GBid.taxa_level.taxonomy.avg_dist = sub(":[0-9\\.]+$", "", X.u.k._.S.G.F.GBid.taxa_level.taxonomy.avg_dist), # Remove avg_dist from taxonomy column
         avg_dist = as.numeric(avg_dist) # Convert to numeric
         ) %>%
  dplyr::rename("MAG" = "X.input_bin",
         "Taxonomy" = "X.u.k._.S.G.F.GBid.taxa_level.taxonomy.avg_dist")
  
taxMAGs <- taxMAGs %>%
  separate(Taxonomy,
           into = c("SGB", "Taxlevel", "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species", "Strain"),
           sep = "[:|]",
           fill = "right",
           remove = FALSE
           ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species), # Remove prefixes such as k__, p__, c__ etc.
                ~ str_replace(., "^[a-z]__", "")),
         Kingdom = ifelse(Unassigned != "", Unassigned, Kingdom),
         Strain = gsub("^t__", "", Strain) # remove leading "t__"
         ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Taxonomy, SGB, Taxlevel, Unassigned))

# Merge with Abricate
abricate <- abricate %>%
  left_join(taxMAGs %>% dplyr::select(Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, Strain, MAG),
            by = c("MAGs" = "MAG")
            )
```

## 2.4 Number of ARG detected on MAGs per child
```{r}
# Number of child per classif
# Turn into named vector for scale_x_discrete labels
counts_classif <- abricate %>% # Count the number of VG_ID per classif
  dplyr::group_by(classif) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n_distinct(VG_ID), .groups = "drop")

# Abbreviations
abbr <- c("Normally nourished" = "NN",
          "Overnourished" = "ON",
          "Undernourished" = "UN")

# Build final x-axis labels
x_labels <- setNames(paste0(abbr[counts_classif$classif], " (n=", counts_classif$n, ")"),
                     counts_classif$classif)

# Calculate the number of ARG detected on each MAGs per child
abricate <- abricate %>%
  dplyr::group_by(VG_ID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ARG_count = sum(NUM_FOUND, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Compute pairwise Wilcoxon tests with rstatix
stat_test <- abricate %>%
  wilcox_test(ARG_count ~ classif,
              comparisons = list(c("Undernourished", "Normally nourished"),
                                 c("Normally nourished", "Overnourished"),
                                 c("Undernourished", "Overnourished")
                                 )
              ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%      # multiple-testing correction
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%          # adds p.adj.signif
  mutate(y.position = max(abricate$ARG_count, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05)

# Plot the data
res_plot = ggplot(abricate, aes(x = classif, y = ARG_count)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +  # boxplot overlay
    #geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +  # jittered points
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    labs(x = NULL, # "Maternal nutritionnal status"
         y = "Number of ARG detected on MAGs per child") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
          ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_test,
                     label = "p.adj.signif",   # uses adjusted p-values
                     tip.length = 0.01,
                     size = 7)
  # + stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", comparisons = list(c("Undernourished", "Normally nourished"),
  #                                                               c("Normally nourished", "Overnourished"),
  #                                                               c("Undernourished", "Overnourished")),
  #                    p.adjust.method = "BH",
  #                    label = "p.signif",
  #                    size = 7)

rm(res_plot, x_labels)
```

## 2.5 Mean number of ARG per species and classif (weighted by N per classif group)
```{r}
# Reshape to long format: keep Species and resistance genes
resistance_long <- abricate %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(MAGs, VG_ID, Database, NUM_FOUND, `#FILE`, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, Strain, howborn, classif, district, district_cat, ARG_count),
               names_to = "Resistance_Gene",
               values_to = "Presence"
               )

# Filter for Present Genes (non-NA) and count Occurrences by Species and Resistance Gene
resistance_counts <- resistance_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(Presence)) %>%
  dplyr::count(Species, Resistance_Gene, classif)
  
# Normalize the count by the proportion of women in each classif
species_totals <- resistance_counts %>%
  left_join(counts_classif, by = "classif") %>%
  dplyr::rename("total_classif" = "n.y",
         "Occ" = "n.x") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(norm_occ = (Occ / total_classif)) 

# Top 2 Species carrying the most resistance genes independently of the classif
top2_species = species_totals %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Species)) # remove rows where Species is NA
 
top2_species = top2_species %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Occ_all = sum(Occ, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # sum over all classif
  dplyr::arrange(desc(Occ_all)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 2)   # keep only top 20

# Subset the normalized dataframe
resistance_top2 <- species_totals %>%
  filter(Species %in% top2_species$Species)

# Reorder Species as factor for plotting
resistance_top2$Species <- str_wrap(resistance_top2$Species, width = 30)

species_order <- resistance_top2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Occ_all = sum(Occ, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # sum over all classif
  dplyr::arrange(desc(Occ_all)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Species)

resistance_top2 <- resistance_top2 %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = species_order))

# Top 10 most abundant resistant genes found in resistance_top2
top10_ARG = resistance_top2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Resistance_Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Occ_all = sum(Occ, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # sum over all classif
  dplyr::arrange(desc(Occ_all)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10)   # keep only top 20

# Subset the normalized dataframe
resistance_top2_ARG10 <- resistance_top2 %>%
  filter(Resistance_Gene %in% top10_ARG$Resistance_Gene)

# Color palette
length(unique(resistance_top2$Resistance_Gene)) # Make a color palette with 58 colors
length(unique(resistance_top2_ARG10$Resistance_Gene)) # Make a color palette with 10 colors

library(Polychrome)
palette <- createPalette(58, seedcolors = c("#FF0000"))  # generates 58 distinct colors
palette_clean <- unname(palette)

# All pairwise comparisons between classif
my_comparisons <- list(c("Normally nourished", "Overnourished"),
                       c("Normally nourished", "Undernourished"),
                       c("Overnourished", "Undernourished")
                       )

# Plot
res = ggplot(resistance_top2_ARG10, aes(x = classif, y = norm_occ, fill = Resistance_Gene)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#AEC7E8FF", "#FFBB78FF", "#98DF8AFF", "#FF9896FF", "#C5B0D5FF", "#C49C94FF", "#F7B6D2FF", "#C7C7C7FF", "#DBDB8DFF", "#9EDAE5FF")) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Normally nourished" = "NN",
                            "Overnourished" = "ON",
                            "Undernourished" = "UN")) +
  labs(title = NULL, # "ARG detected per Species and classif"
       x = NULL, # "Maternal nutritionnal status"
       y = "Normalized number of ARG detected",
       fill = "Resistance Gene") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 16),
        legend.position = "right") + # angle = 90, hjust = 1
  facet_wrap(~ Species) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons,
                     method = "wilcox.test",
                     # label = "p.format",
                     hide.ns = FALSE,
                     symnum.args = list(cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), symbols = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))
                     )

rm(res, top5_species, y_positions, my_comparisons, colors_58, resistance_top5, species_order, resistance_counts, counts_classif)
```

## 2.6 Focus on beta-lactam
```{r}
# Filter the abricate database for all the betalactam (bla) genes
abricate_bla <- resistance_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(Presence)) %>%
  filter(grepl("bla", Resistance_Gene, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  select(-ARG_count)

# Count the different bla genes
bla_counts <- abricate_bla %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Resistance_Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
bla_counts

# Calculate the number of ARG detected per child
abricate_bla <- abricate_bla %>%
  group_by(VG_ID) %>%
  mutate(ARG_count = sum(NUM_FOUND, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Boxplot representation
abricate_bla_unique = abricate_bla %>%
  distinct(VG_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

BL_plot = ggplot(abricate_bla_unique, aes(x = classif, y = ARG_count)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +  # boxplot overlay
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +  # jittered points
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Normally nourished" = "NN",
                              "Overnourished"      = "ON",
                              "Undernourished"     = "UN")) +
    labs(x = "Maternal nutritionnal status", y = "Number of Beta-Lactam gene detected") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
          ) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", comparisons = list(c("Undernourished", "Normally nourished"),
                                                                c("Normally nourished", "Overnourished"),
                                                                c("Undernourished", "Overnourished")),
                     label = "p")

rm(beta_lactam, beta_lactam_occ, BL_plot)
```

## 3.1 ESBL isolation
```{r}
# ESBL
esbl = read_excel("Supplementary_table16.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)

# Plot the resistant esbl (mother - child)
df_counts <- esbl %>%
  dplyr::count(Individual, Species)

df_counts <- df_counts %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = unique(Species)))

ggplot(df_counts, aes(x = Species, y = n, fill = Individual)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Number of isolations") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, face = "italic"))

# Multi-drug resistance testing
res_profile_esbl = read_excel("Supplementary_table17.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)

res_profile_esbl <- res_profile_esbl %>%
  mutate(betalactam = ifelse(Ampicillin < 2.6 | Amoxicillin < 2.6 | Cefotaxime < 2.6,
                             1, 0),
         fluoroquinolones = ifelse(Ciprofloxacin < 2.6,
                                   1, 0),
         Amphenicols = ifelse(Chloramphenicol < 2.6,
                              1, 0),
  )

res_profile_esbl <- res_profile_esbl %>%
  mutate(MDR = ifelse(betalactam == 1 & fluoroquinolones == 1 & Amphenicols == 1,
                      1, 0)
         )

print(res_profile_esbl)
```

## 3.2 Taxonomic overlap between M and C (potential transmission)
```{r}
# Non-ESBL resistant isolates (LAB)
LAB_isolates = read_excel("Supplementary_table18.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)

# Merge with ESBL
cols_to_keep <- c("VG_ID", "Individual", "Species", "Resistance")

all_isolation <- bind_rows(esbl %>% select(all_of(cols_to_keep)),
                           LAB_isolates %>% select(all_of(cols_to_keep))
                           )

# Which species are found in both children and mothers?
sp_mother <- all_isolation %>%
  filter(Individual == "mother") %>%
  distinct(Species) %>%
  pull(Species)

sp_child <- all_isolation %>%
  filter(Individual == "child") %>%
  distinct(Species) %>%
  pull(Species)

shared_species <- intersect(sp_mother, sp_child)
shared_species # there are 16 species (isolates) that are taxonomically overlapping between children and mothers (related and unrelated pairs)

# Per VG_ID: do mother and child share any species?
overlap_by_vg <- all_isolation %>%
  filter(Individual %in% c("mother", "child")) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(VG_ID, Individual, Species) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(VG_ID, Species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_individuals = n_distinct(Individual), .groups = "drop") %>% # For each (VG_ID, Species) group, count how many distinct Individual values occur. (1 = only in one of the individuals / 2 = in both)
  dplyr::mutate(shared = n_individuals == 2) %>% # shared = TRUE if n_individuals is 2 (present in both mother & child), otherwise FALSE
  dplyr::group_by(VG_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_shared_species = sum(shared),
    shared_species = paste(Species[shared], collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

overlap_by_vg

overlap_by_vg_shared = overlap_by_vg %>%
  filter(n_shared_species > 0) %>%
  separate_rows(shared_species, sep = ",") %>%           # split "A, B" into 2 rows
  mutate(shared_species = str_trim(shared_species))      # remove leading spaces
# Out of the 99 VG_ID tested for resistant isolates, taxonomic overlapped was found in 24 related pairs (24.24%). 

```
